Definition
Source: topping:page-0021 1. ch1:4.1\group three-manifolds A geometry is a simply connected, homogeneous, unimodular Riemannian manifold.

Here homogeneous means that any two points are related by an isometry, and unimodular means that a discrete group of isometries acts with compact quotient.
